applies_to: all Barnase--Barstar IR-IVM members in this campaign, prospectively and retrospectively
decision_timing: after the alpha=10 r3 terminal NoF ledger was available and before any densified Delta E diagnostic for the 990-N_F confirmations

hard_budget_rule.cost_axis_value: actual optimization Number of Forces consumed
hard_budget_rule.registered_budget_B: a hard upper bound, not permission to overshoot in order to reach equality
valid_atomic_remainder_case: all physical joint attempts equal all successful joint evaluations and the sum over the 30 internal-image cache misses
fixed-endpoint attempts and misses are zero
the terminal partial tail is present and quarantined
hard_budget_rule.invalid_cases: overshoot, failed physical attempt, inconsistent counters, endpoint charge, unquarantined partial tail, or any other early-stop reason

reason: An indivisible complete-band preflight must stop before overshoot when the remaining budget cannot fund the next atomic band. Requiring numerical equality would reject the only counter-consistent no-overshoot terminal state and would encourage incorrect over-counting or overshoot.
